description: Trust nothing you did not recompute. Verifies the Ed25519 signature on the current sum-log head (the Merkle-sum root over every counted payment and the total it commits to), optionally climbs one agent's proof from its leaf to the root and the whole total, reports how many of the previous head's leaves the current head declares unchanged, changed, removed and added, and verifies the statement log's signed tree head and, given the head you kept (tree_size, root_hash), the consistency proof that our statement history was not rewritten. Keep the heads it returns and pass them next time. Definitions sumlog.v1 and agent.statement.log.v1.

agent.description: Optional: an agent token id whose proof to climb

previous_head.description: Optional: the sum-log head you kept: { leaves, root }

previous_statement_head.description: Optional: the statement-log head you kept: { tree_size, root_hash }

name: verify_sum_log
title: Verify our published total and our statement log (skeptical client)
